register.passwordHint_one: At least {{count}} character. You'll get a recovery code next: keep it safe, it's the only way to reset a forgotten password.
register.passwordHint_other: At least {{count}} characters. You'll get a recovery code next: keep it safe, it's the only way to reset a forgotten password.
register.registered: Registered! You can now log in.
register.inviteHint: Signing up needs an invite from an admin.
register.requestHint: New accounts wait for an admin to approve them. Have an invite? Enter it to skip the wait.

recover.title: Reset your password
recover.hint: Enter the recovery code you saved when you made your account (or in Settings), and choose a new password. Your messages stay.

recoveryCode.title: Save your recovery code
recoveryCode.introNoCode: Your account doesn't have a recovery code yet, so here's one.

errors.keysLockedWithCode: Couldn't unlock your encryption keys with that code.
errors.publicKeysMismatchLogin: The server's copy of your public keys doesn't match your account. Not logging in.
errors.publicKeysMismatch: The server's copy of your public keys doesn't match your account.
errors.passwordTooShort_one: Use a password of at least {{count}} character.
errors.passwordTooShort_other: Use a password of at least {{count}} characters.
errors.notARecoveryCode: That doesn't look like a recovery code. It's 25 letters and numbers.
errors.invalidInvite: That invite doesn't work: it may have expired or been used up.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Your account, {{username}}, has been made. An admin needs to approve it before you can use Voicaw.
pending.opensByItself: Keep this page open if you like: the app opens by itself once you're approved. You can also log out and log in again later.
pending.withdrawHint: This deletes your account straight away. Enter your password to confirm.
